title: Melted Film and a Dramatic Cross-Country Drive: How One Filmmaker Captured a Total Solar Eclipse for IMAX 70MM
summary: With the help of Kodak, Gus Bendinelli recently premiered his short film ‘Eclipse’ in the same Universal CityWalk theater that screens ‘Oppenheimer’ and ‘Sinners’. He says, “An eclipse might be the closest thing nature has to a movie.”
